items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.title: Show HN: Free Temporary and Mock REST API for Front End Developers
items.contentSnippet:
SonoJS Mock is a free toolkit for frontend developers.
Mock REST API: JSONPlaceholder-style resources.
Temporary API: Create disposable REST endpoints with GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE.
Fake Data Generator: Generate realistic JSON fixtures.
Image Generator: Free placeholder images and photos.
JSON Workbench: Format, compare, search, and convert JSON.
No account required for Temporary APIs.

items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: A free browser backgammon club, gnubg's net under the hood
items.contentSnippet:
Using Spawn, I've been building The Velvet Point, a rainy-night backgammon club you play in the browser (desktop or phone). You can play the house opponents or real people, and chat at the tables. You will also get analytical (as well as snarky) comments from the AI opponents. Social features, leaderboards (ratings, PR, chips) also baked in.
Has a review feature to show the best moves after your move. So no "hint" or tutoring before the move. I think you will learn better when you make a mistake

items.title: Show HN: ClawdTime, a CUA agent for long tasks that FaceTimes you when stuck
items.contentSnippet:
I often use Codex/Claude for long-running tasks such as coding or video editing and hate it when it gets stuck while I’m away from my computer. I want a way to check in and operate my computer without being at my computer.
So I built ClawdTime. It FaceTimes me whenever it needs my input or has something to show me, and it zooms into the relevant window. I can also FaceTime it and have it run tasks on my Mac while it shares the screen.
All comments welcome!
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.
